title.zh: 网页是怎么来到你手机上的
title.en: How a Web Page Reaches Your Phone

desc.zh: 从点下链接到看见页面，那不到一秒花在了哪里？八个可以动手的模型：查名字、切成小包、一跳一跳地转发、排队和丢包、确认与重传、拥塞窗口、密钥交换，以及光速定下的时间预算。
desc.en: Where does the second between tapping a link and seeing the page go? Eight models you can push: looking up the name, cutting data into packets, hop-by-hop routing, queues and loss, acknowledgement and retransmission, the congestion window, key exchange, and the time budget set by the speed of light.

desc.zh: 解析器从根服务器起逐级问路，把名字换成数字地址，并按 TTL 把答案记一段时间。
desc.en: A resolver follows referrals from the root down to turn a name into an address, and caches each answer for its TTL.

zh: 为什么第一次打开网站慢
en: how does a domain name become an IP address

desc.zh: 数据切成带信封的小包，经过多段线路时可以流水线式同时前进；包太大要等，太小信封占比高。
desc.en: Data is cut into packets with headers so several links can work at once; too big and each hop waits, too small and headers dominate.

en: how is data sent over the internet

desc.zh: 每台路由器只记“下一步交给谁”，由最短路算法算出；一条线断了，路线自己重新形成。
desc.en: Each router keeps only the next hop, computed by a shortest-path algorithm; when a link breaks the route re-forms.

en: how does data find its way

desc.zh: 路由器缓冲区排满就丢包；负载超过 1 时加大缓冲区只是把丢包换成等待（缓冲膨胀）。
desc.en: A full router buffer drops packets; above full load, a bigger buffer only trades loss for delay (bufferbloat).

title.zh: 确认与重传：TCP 怎样做到可靠

desc.zh: 编号、确认、超时重传把会丢包的网络变成可靠的字节流；丢掉的包会挡住后面已到的包（队头阻塞）。
desc.en: Numbering, acknowledgements and timeouts turn a lossy network into a reliable stream; a lost packet holds up the ones behind it (head-of-line blocking).

title.zh: 拥塞窗口：慢启动与锯齿

desc.zh: 慢启动成倍试探，丢包后砍半、此后每个来回加一：窗口画出锯齿，几个连接自动分匀。
desc.en: Slow start doubles, a loss halves the window and it then grows by one per round trip: a sawtooth, and competing flows even out.

zh: 几个人一起下载怎么分网速

desc.zh: 两人当众交换 g 的幂的余数，就能算出只有彼此知道的钥匙；但它防不了中间人，还要证书。
desc.en: Exchanging powers of g modulo p in public yields a key only the two parties know; it cannot stop a man in the middle, hence certificates.

zh: 公开喊话怎么约定密码

title.zh: 延迟预算：来回次数 × 光速
title.en: Latency budget: round trips × the speed of light

desc.zh: 打开网页的时间约等于来回次数乘以每个来回的时间；光纤里光速约 20 万公里每秒，所以远方服务器有不可逾越的下限，CDN 靠缩短距离。
desc.en: Load time is roughly round trips × round-trip time; light in fibre does about 200,000 km/s, so a distant server has a hard floor, and a CDN shortens the distance.

title.en: Three questions when a page is slow

desc.zh: 来回了几次、每个来回多远、路上有没有排队丢包。
desc.en: How many round trips, how far each one goes, and whether packets are queuing or being lost.

en: what happens when you click a link
how does a web page load
why is the second visit faster
